svg.title: xor.ad panel — the full kit, 46 components
svg.desc: The inventory of neobrutalism.dev (46 components, read from its repository), drawn in this project's system: 2px frames, 4px hard offset shadows, radius 6, control height 36, the light palette's real values. The holders are hairlines so the exhibits stay the loudest thing on the page.

g.text: The inventory of neobrutalism.dev, read out of its repository and redrawn in our geometry. Green = built here. Blue = drawn only.
intent picks the fill, never the geometry
neutral by default; colour is spent on
a circle is the one round thing here
keeps the layout it is standing in for,
so nothing jumps when the data lands
a counter appears past 80% of a limit
square is many-of; the tick is drawn, not typed
round is one-of, and always in a fieldset
styled in App.css; no page has needed one yet
acts at once. A checkbox waits for the
closed, and open with the chosen one filled
a select you can type into: the typed part is bold
the value is always printed — a handle
on a track is not a number
one box per digit, paste fills them all,
and the caret is where the next one goes
today is boxed; the weekend is muted
a hint sits here, one line
label above · hint below · error replaces the hint
the bar is drawn, not the browser's
Shown once — the relay keeps a hash.
the picture is framed by the card, not floated
Yes — it follows the WAI-ARIA pattern
the open one is filled; the caret turns
one strip, one click — the kit's own fold
weight and a rule — a tab is not a button
the seam is a control, so it is drawn like one
SHOWN ONCE ★ COPY IT NOW ★ SHOW
a strip that runs. Respects reduced motion —
and if it stops, the text must still be readable
the panel has no use for it yet
a scrim, focus trapped, Esc closes it
Anything using it stops at once.
no dismiss by scrim; the danger is filled here
slides from an edge and keeps the page behind
the phone's dialog: from the bottom, with a
grab handle, dismissed by dragging down
holds controls; a tooltip holds only words
opens on dwell, never on a tap
explains; never holds the only copy of
destructive last, after a rule, with an ellipsis
the same menu, summoned by the right button
for an app with modes; the panel has pages
stacks, the newest in front; never carries
the last one is where you are, and is not a link
a menu with descriptions, for a site, not a panel
a log has no page numbers to give —
at 751px a row becomes a card of
selection, sorting, columns — a table that acts
a gap is a gap — an empty bucket is not
known length · unknown · a meter, which is
a quantity rather than a wait
The key is shown once. Copy it now.
This key has no origins — it will be refused.

Not one of these is implemented by this drawing. Pick what the panel actually needs; the rest is a catalogue, not a plan.
